periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline, converging toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid/teardrop shape with a height approximately 1.8 to 2 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior elongation; the distance from the centroid to the ventral tip is greater than the distance to the dorsal tip.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick lateral bands occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible torso height at the shoulder junction.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide-set placement with an inter-pinna gap approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Continuous convex curvature along the superior margins, appearing circular and smooth.
